subject: prd/feature-draft
statement: Where GitHub is selected, the system shall authenticate an Argus approval from the host review's account identity and commit ID and a closed versioned driver decision binding repository, PR number, exact head, pre-merge policy commit, drive slug, prepared contract digest when applicable, and review evidence. It shall accept the same-account author's COMMENTED review only with that decision, and record the approval as Argus rather than human. The existing authenticated operator review and explicit local-git declared receipt routes shall remain supported.
rationale: Supports an honest agent decision without impersonation or a second account requirement
fit_criterion: Same-account COMMENTED and distinct-account APPROVED driver decisions pass; ordinary comments, malformed payloads, wrong accounts, stale heads, policy commits, and digests refuse; old human lock tags and local receipts remain readable.
